title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to System 1 Models: Fast Decision-Making Beyond LLMS
abstract: arXiv:2610.33775v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models excel at reasoning and generation but their autoregressive, token-by-token inference makes them unnecessarily slow, expensive, and poorly calibrated for the many routine decisions (routing, gating, scoring, classification) that modern AI systems require at sub-second latency. A growing class of models addresses this gap: System 1 decision models, architectures that map an input directly to a typed, structured decision in a single forward pass. This guide provides a comprehensive, practitioner-oriented treatment of the field. We propose a five-family taxonomy covering encoder-based classifiers, reward models, non-autoregressive decision engines, contrastive decision models, and extraction models, and we provide in-depth coverage of each family's architecture, training methodology, and deployment trade-offs. translated_title: 《系统1模型搭车客指南：超越大语言模型的快速决策》
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在推理和生成方面表现出色，但其自回归的逐token推理方式使其在处理现代AI系统所需的众多亚秒级延迟的常规决策（如路由、门控、评分、分类）时，变得不必要地缓慢、昂贵且校准不佳。一类不断壮大的模型正在填补这一空白：系统1决策模型——一种能够在单次前向传播中将输入直接映射为类型化、结构化决策的架构。本指南为该领域提供了全面的、面向从业者的论述。我们提出了一个五大家族的分类体系，涵盖基于编码器的分类器、奖励模型、非自回归决策引擎、对比决策模型和提取模型，并深入介绍了每个家族的架构、训练方法和部署权衡。贯穿全文的核心主题是校准：我们发展了适当评分规则的理论，并分析了强化学习（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本指南提出了系统1决策模型的五大家族分类体系——这类模型通过单次前向传播即可直接输出结构化决策，为现代AI系统中需要亚秒级延迟的常规决策任务提供了比大语言模型更快、更便宜且校准更好的替代方案。
en_tdlr: This guide proposes a five-family taxonomy of System 1 decision models—architectures that map inputs directly to structured decisions in a single forward pass—offering fast, cheap, and well-calibrated alternatives to LLMs for routine sub-second-latency decisions in modern AI systems.
